description:
# PR: Registry & Admin Stats Caching

Closes #1680

## Summary

This PR implements Redis-backed caching with in-memory fallback for registry entities and admin statistics, reducing database queries and improving response times for high-traffic endpoints.

## What Was Implemented

### New Cache Infrastructure

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `mcpgateway/cache/registry_cache.py` | Redis + in-memory hybrid cache for registry entities (tools, prompts, resources, servers, gateways, agents, catalog) |
| `mcpgateway/cache/admin_stats_cache.py` | Cache for admin statistics (system stats, observability, users, teams, tags, plugins, performance) |

### Cached Endpoints

| Entity | List Method | TTL | Cache Key Pattern |
|--------|-------------|-----|-------------------|
| Tools | `list_tools()` | 20s | `mcpgw:reg:tools:{filters_hash}` |
| Prompts | `list_prompts()` | 20s | `mcpgw:reg:prompts:{filters_hash}` |
| Resources | `list_resources()` | 15s | `mcpgw:reg:resources:{filters_hash}` |
| Servers | `list_servers()` | 20s | `mcpgw:reg:servers:{filters_hash}` |
| Gateways | `list_gateways()` | 20s | `mcpgw:reg:gateways:{filters_hash}` |
| A2A Agents | `list_agents()` | 20s | `mcpgw:reg:agents:{filters_hash}` |
| Catalog | `get_catalog_servers()` | 60s | `mcpgw:reg:catalog:{filters_hash}` |
| System Stats | `get_system_stats()` | 30s | `mcpgw:admin:system_stats` |
| Tags | `get_all_tags()` | 120s | `mcpgw:admin:tags:{cache_key}` |
| Plugin Stats | `get_plugin_statistics()` | 120s | `mcpgw:admin:plugins` |
| Performance | `get_history()` | 60s | `mcpgw:admin:perf:{cache_key}` |

### Cache Invalidation

All entity mutation methods now invalidate the appropriate caches:

| Service | Create | Update | Delete | Tags Invalidation |
|---------|--------|--------|--------|-------------------|
| `tool_service.py` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `prompt_service.py` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `resource_service.py` | - | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `server_service.py` | - | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `gateway_service.py` | - | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `a2a_service.py` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `catalog_service.py` | ✅ | - | - | - |

### Configuration

New environment variables added:

```bash
# Registry Cache
REGISTRY_CACHE_ENABLED=true
REGISTRY_CACHE_TOOLS_TTL=20
REGISTRY_CACHE_PROMPTS_TTL=20
REGISTRY_CACHE_RESOURCES_TTL=15
REGISTRY_CACHE_SERVERS_TTL=20
REGISTRY_CACHE_GATEWAYS_TTL=20
REGISTRY_CACHE_AGENTS_TTL=20
REGISTRY_CACHE_CATALOG_TTL=60

# Admin Stats Cache
ADMIN_STATS_CACHE_ENABLED=true
ADMIN_STATS_CACHE_SYSTEM_STATS_TTL=30
ADMIN_STATS_CACHE_OBSERVABILITY_TTL=60
ADMIN_STATS_CACHE_USERS_TTL=60
ADMIN_STATS_CACHE_TEAMS_TTL=60
ADMIN_STATS_CACHE_TAGS_TTL=120
ADMIN_STATS_CACHE_PLUGINS_TTL=120
ADMIN_STATS_CACHE_PERFORMANCE_TTL=60
```

### Documentation

- `docs/docs/architecture/adr/029-registry-admin-stats-caching.md` - Architecture Decision Record
- `docs/docs/manage/configuration.md` - Configuration reference updated

## What Was NOT Implemented

### Deferred (ORM Object Limitations)

| Item | Reason |
|------|--------|
| Public Teams Discovery (`list_public_teams()`) | Returns ORM objects; callers use `.get_member_count()` method |
| LLM Providers/Models | Returns ORM objects; callers depend on ORM attributes |
| Users List (`list_users()`) | Returns ORM objects; callers use `EmailUserResponse.from_email_user()` |

### Deferred (Low Priority / Higher Risk)

| Item | Risk Level | Reason |
|------|------------|--------|
| JWT Token Validation | 🔴 High | Security-critical; caching could allow revoked tokens |
| Team Membership Check | 🔴 High | Authorization-critical; stale data = security issue |
| Permission Checks | 🔴 High | Security-critical |
| Rate Limit Counters | 🔴 High | Must be real-time accurate |
| Audit Trail Queries | 🟠 Medium | Compliance requirements for real-time data |
| Active Sessions | 🟠 Medium | Security monitoring needs real-time data |

### Not Started

| Item | Notes |
|------|-------|
| Auth Caching (ADR-028) | Planned separately; see `docs/docs/architecture/adr/028-auth-caching.md` |
| Query Batching | Would require significant refactoring of auth flow |

## Architecture

### Cache Pattern

```
Request → Check Cache → Hit? → Return cached data
                    ↓ Miss
              Query Database → Store in Cache → Return data
```

### Fallback Strategy

```
Redis Available? → Use Redis (primary)
        ↓ No
Use In-Memory Cache (fallback)
```

### Thread Safety

- Uses `threading.Lock` for in-memory cache operations
- Redis operations are inherently atomic
- Async-safe with proper `await` usage

## Testing

### Unit Tests Updated

- `tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_tag_service.py` - Added cache clearing fixture
- `tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_plugin_service.py` - Made tests async
- `tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_performance_service.py` - Made tests async

### Verification Commands

```bash
# Run all service tests
uv run pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/ -v

# Run caching-specific tests
uv run pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_tag_service.py \
    tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_plugin_service.py \
    tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_performance_service.py -v

# Lint check
make flake8 bandit pylint
```

## Performance Impact

Expected improvements under load:

| Metric | Before | After |
|--------|--------|-------|
| List endpoints P50 | 15-25ms | 2-5ms (cache hit) |
| DB queries per list | 1-3 | 0 (cache hit) |
| Cache hit rate | N/A | >80% under steady load |

## Files Changed

### New Files
- `mcpgateway/cache/registry_cache.py`
- `mcpgateway/cache/admin_stats_cache.py`
- `docs/docs/architecture/adr/029-registry-admin-stats-caching.md`
